**Neal Thomas Smith** is a former [Hot Wheels](/wiki/Hot_Wheels) designer who worked with [Mattel](/wiki/Mattel) from [2013](/wiki/2013) to [2023](/wiki/2023) and last held the position of Senior/Lead Product Designer. He has primarily aided in the development of various track and play sets, assisted with the launch of the [Minecraft](/wiki/Minecraft_Character_Cars), [Monster Trucks](/wiki/Hot_Wheels_Monster_Trucks), and [Skate](/wiki/Hot_Wheels_Skate) series, as well as some prototyping and other work for larger scale series. Neal has been tasked with the creation of 1/64 scale models and liveries on occasion. He is known for using the pseudonyms “NEEEL” and “Dr. Neeel” on his public social media accounts. He currently works at Buck Knives as an Industrial Design Specialist.
